title: Credit on a part sale invoice lists an inactive part with its tag
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] (Sell Price $20.00) and [Part-B] (Sell Price $15.00) = two tracked parts, quantity 4 each, both sold once on the invoice [Inv-1] of a part sale; [Part-A] is set inactive after the invoice.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PSCR PART A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSCR-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSCR-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PSCR PART A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PSCR PART B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSCR-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $15.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSCR-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PSCR PART B).
  5. Go to Customers, create a customer named (e.g.) "ZZAUTOTEST PL PSCR Customer" and save it. [Cust-1] = that customer.
  6. Go to Parts → Part Sales, start a new part sale for [Cust-1]. [PS-1] = the part sale number shown (e.g. P2-89).
  7. On [PS-1] open the Parts tab, click "Add Part", type [Part-A] in Part Number, pick the inventory row, set Quantity to 1 and click "Save & Close".
  8. On [PS-1] open the Parts tab, click "Add Part", type [Part-B] in Part Number, pick the inventory row, set Quantity to 1 and click "Save & Close".
  9. On [PS-1] pick both parts (status "Picked"), then on the Finance tab click "Create Invoice". [Inv-1] = the invoice shown.
  10. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  11. Check the setup worked: [Inv-1] exists on the part sale with [Part-A] $20.00 and [Part-B] $15.00; [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open [PS-1] and its Finance tab.
  2. Open the invoice's ⋮ menu and click "Issue Credit".
  3. Tick "Parts are being returned".
  4. Read the "Parts to return" list.
  5. Click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: Both parts are listed: [Part-A] at $20.00 and [Part-B] at $15.00. [Part-A] carries a grey "Inactive" tag right after its part number; [Part-B] has none.
  • Step 5: The credit dialog closes with nothing issued.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-R13, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.7 (Part sale credit: still offered, tagged). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R13: “A credit on any invoice, from a part sale or a work order, lists the parts sold on the invoice, active or inactive. A part that is now inactive carries the grey "Inactive" tag beside its part number.”
